A1.justification: Both complete, readable 18-page PDFs describe the same DDA work and contain corresponding main sections, Appendices A–F, tables, figures and equations.

before.justification: v4 reports original detector evaluations, timing measurements, robustness tests, ablations and regional detection results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The VAE reconstruction, frequency-coefficient replacement and pixel-mixup procedure remain identical, as do the detector architecture and training approach.

E1.justification: Both retain MSCOCO-based training and the same ten evaluation datasets, including AIGCDetectionBenchmark and ForenSynth in Appendix C. No task or test-scenario coverage changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same comparator rows, including VAE Rec. in the main comparisons and B-Free in Tables 9 and 14. No baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Training settings, cropping, JPEG preprocessing, evaluation metrics, sample counts and the multiple-crop protocol in Table 14 are unchanged. No evaluation design is revised.

E4.justification: The frequency-bias analyses, Figure 9 robustness tests, Figure 10 and Tables 15–17 ablations, feature visualizations and Appendix F regional analysis are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The performance and timing tables retain the same mean and standard-deviation reporting. No seed information, repeated-run disclosure, confidence intervals or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported values and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, DDA remains 97.4 ± 1.2 on DRCT-2M in Table 4 and 90.8 ± 7.3 across ten datasets in Table 11.

T1.justification: The reconstruction and mixup definitions in Equations (1)–(3) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the same claims about frequency-level bias, dual-domain alignment, detector generalization and the DDA-COCO/EvalGEN contributions.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, interpretations of the results and ablations, and limitations involving heavy post-processing and smartphone enhancement are unchanged, including the appendix discussions.

D1.justification: v5 adds an explicit code-availability statement and repository link in the abstract, absent from v4. Implementation details and dataset-construction instructions otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B and the same 42 reference entries retain the same cited works and research positioning.

P1.justification: The abstract gains a short code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific prose, terminology and section order are retained.

P2.justification: Spacing and text reflow shift section starts, the GenImage footnote and other passages across page boundaries. Figures 1–13 and Tables 1–17 retain their content and structure.

improvement.justification: The new abstract-level repository link supplies a concrete code-access reference missing from v4, modestly improving reproducibility documentation. Scientific evidence and limitations remain unchanged. The PDFs establish this documentation benefit, but cannot establish the linked code's completeness or usability.
